01 / about

I'm a full stack developer with four years at Aeon Media, where my responsibilities grew to main backend ownership. I build Rails and GraphQL APIs, React/Next.js interfaces and AWS systems, working with editorial and production teams to turn their requirements into useful features.

My work includes a staged authentication/CMS migration, an AWS image-processing migration that reduced overall image costs by approximately 80% including AWS costs, and article audio using the ElevenLabs API. I enjoy making clear technical choices and carrying them through to production.

Before software development, I worked in IT support and network deployment support. I hold a Bachelor of Biomedical Science from Monash University and have also supported coding students as a teaching assistant.

I'm based in Osaka, hold JLPT N2, and am studying for N1 in December 2026. I'm open to mid-level and senior developer roles that let me continue living in Osaka, including remote work within Japan.

Away from the screen: running, hiking, bouldering and exploring Kansai.

tools / Ruby on Rails · TypeScript · React · Next.js · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · AWS · Terraform

02 / experience

Aeon Media ↗Full Stack Web Developer

July 2022 – June 2026

Worked across Aeon, Psyche and Sophia Club, growing from junior development into backend architecture ownership.

Owned the backend migration of authentication and custom CMS tools to GraphQL in January–March 2025, working in a five-person engineering team. Kept the new APIs within Rails and introduced a separate Next.js frontend through a production CMS beta and gradual rollout.

Worked with publishing teams to improve tools used by approximately 30–40 editors and production staff. Contributed to frontend architecture, design and implementation, including shadcn and TanStack Query choices, enabling React/Next.js developers to contribute directly to the CMS and authentication tools.

In May 2025, moved image optimisation from Vercel into AWS using CloudFront, Lambda and S3, implementing infrastructure, backend and frontend changes. Reduced overall image costs by approximately 80%, including the added AWS costs, and partnered with the SRE on Terraform deployment. The custom pipeline later enabled cropping within the CMS, replacing the image curator's manual local workflow.

From October to December 2025, headed article-audio implementation for Aeon and Psyche using the ElevenLabs API. Built backend APIs and infrastructure and assigned audio-player design to a frontend developer. Worked closely with production on date/number preprocessing and CMS pronunciation controls, and with marketing on podcast releases to Spotify, YouTube and Apple Podcasts.

Also contributed to AI moderation assistance, image alt text, two-factor authentication and session-management improvements.
